tag: 團體住宿延長一晚並改換樓層

level.why: 三人對話先訂定三晚、後因會議改期延長並改換樓層，需整合多句資訊判斷意圖與後續行動。

dialogue.t: Good afternoon, and welcome to the Lakeview Hotel. How may I help you two?
dialogue.zh: 午安，歡迎光臨湖景飯店。有什麼我可以為兩位效勞的嗎？

dialogue.t: Hi. We have two single rooms for three nights, under the name Rivera, for the design fair.
dialogue.zh: 嗨。我們以 Rivera 的名字訂了兩間單人房、三個晚上，為了參加設計展。

dialogue.t: I see them. Both rooms are on the sixth floor, and breakfast is served from six thirty.
dialogue.zh: 我查到了。兩間都在六樓，早餐從六點半開始供應。

dialogue.t: Actually, Dana, the fair organizers just emailed me. Our final meeting has been moved to Saturday morning.
dialogue.zh: 其實，Dana，展覽主辦單位剛寄信給我。我們最後的會議改到週六早上了。

dialogue.t: So we'll need to stay one more night. Can you extend both rooms through Saturday, please?
dialogue.zh: 所以我們得多住一晚。可以請你把兩間房延長到週六嗎？

dialogue.t: Let me look. The sixth floor is full on Friday, but I can offer you two rooms on the fourth floor.
dialogue.zh: 我看看。六樓週五客滿了，但我可以給兩位四樓的兩間房。

dialogue.t: Are the fourth-floor rooms quiet? I need to prepare my presentation tonight and tomorrow night.
dialogue.zh: 四樓的房間安靜嗎？我今晚和明晚都得準備我的簡報。

dialogue.t: Very quiet. They face the garden, while the sixth-floor rooms look out on the main road.
dialogue.zh: 非常安靜。它們面向花園，而六樓房間面對大馬路。

dialogue.t: That's actually better for us. Please change both rooms to the fourth floor for all four nights.
dialogue.zh: 那對我們反而更好。請把兩間房都改到四樓，住滿四晚。

dialogue.t: Done. I'll print new key cards, and a bellhop can carry your bags up shortly.
dialogue.zh: 好了。我會印新的房卡，行李員很快會幫兩位把行李送上去。

dialogue.t: Thanks. Could you also arrange a wake-up call at six tomorrow? The fair opens at eight, and we need to be there early.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。可以也幫我們安排明天六點的晨喚嗎？展覽八點開始，我們得提早到。

q.t: Why do the speakers need an extra night?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼需要多住一晚？

choices.t: The fair opens a day earlier.
choices.why: 是會議延後到週六，而非提前。

choices.t: The sixth-floor rooms were not ready.
choices.why: 對話沒說房間未備妥。

choices.t: Their final meeting was rescheduled.
choices.zh: 他們最後的會議改期了。
choices.why: 男士說最後的會議改到週六早上，所以要多住。

choices.t: The hotel is full on Friday.
choices.why: 只有六樓週五客滿，且那是換房原因而非多住原因。

q.t: Why does the man ask, "Are the fourth-floor rooms quiet?"
q.zh: 男士為什麼問「四樓的房間安靜嗎？」

choices.t: He wants to avoid the garden.
choices.why: 花園景觀是後來客服介紹的優點，他並未排斥。

choices.t: He needs a calm place to work.
choices.zh: 他需要安靜的地方工作。
choices.why: 他接著說今晚和明晚要準備簡報。

choices.t: He is unhappy with the breakfast time.
choices.why: 早餐時間與此問題無關。

choices.t: He wants to move back to the sixth floor.
choices.why: 他是在確認四樓是否適合，不是想回六樓。

q.t: What will the clerk most likely do for the guests?
q.zh: 櫃檯人員接下來最可能為旅客做什麼？

choices.t: Move them back to the sixth floor
choices.why: 六樓週五客滿，且已決定改四樓。

choices.t: Contact the fair organizers
choices.why: 主辦單位是寄信給男士，不需櫃檯聯絡。

choices.t: Print the man's presentation
choices.why: 她要印的是房卡，不是簡報。

choices.t: Set up an early morning call
choices.why: 男士請她安排明天六點的 wake-up call。

tag: 三位室友討論備用房改成書房

level.why: 三人討論先提出沙發床方案、再改用摺疊床墊，需判斷說話意圖並整合多句資訊。

dialogue.t: Okay, everyone, we need to decide what to do with the spare bedroom before the end of the month.
dialogue.zh: 好，各位，我們得在月底前決定備用臥室要怎麼用。

dialogue.t: I'd like to turn it into a home office. Working at the kitchen table is getting impossible.
dialogue.zh: 我想把它改成居家辦公室。在廚房餐桌工作越來越不可能了。

dialogue.t: That makes sense, but my cousin is hoping to stay with us for a few weeks this summer.
dialogue.zh: 有道理，但我表妹今年夏天想來跟我們住幾個星期。

dialogue.t: We could buy a sofa bed for the office. Then it would work for both purposes.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以為辦公室買張沙發床，這樣兩種用途都能兼顧。

dialogue.t: A sofa bed would take up too much space, and I'd need room for two monitors and a bookshelf.
dialogue.zh: 沙發床會佔太多空間，而我需要放兩台螢幕和一個書架。

dialogue.t: What about a fold-out mattress instead? We could store it in the closet when she's not here.
dialogue.zh: 改用摺疊床墊如何？她不在時我們可以收進衣櫃。

dialogue.t: Good idea. That's cheaper, too. Still, the desk should be small, or the room will feel crowded.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，也比較便宜。不過書桌要小一點，不然房間會顯得擁擠。

dialogue.t: Fine. I'll look for a narrow desk, and I'll measure the wall before I order anything.
dialogue.zh: 好。我會找窄一點的書桌，而且訂購前會先量牆面。

dialogue.t: Great. Meanwhile, I'll ask my cousin which weeks she's planning to visit so we can avoid conflicts.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。同時我會問表妹打算哪幾週來，以避免衝突。

dialogue.t: And I'll paint the walls a lighter color this weekend if someone helps me. The dark green makes the room feel smaller.
dialogue.zh: 我這週末會把牆漆成淺一點的顏色，如果有人幫我的話。深綠色讓房間顯得更小。

dialogue.t: I'm free Saturday afternoon, so count me in. Then I can start moving furniture on Monday.
dialogue.zh: 我週六下午有空，算我一份。這樣我週一就能開始搬家具。

q.t: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
q.zh: 說話者主要在討論什麼？

choices.t: Where to hold a family gathering
choices.why: 表妹來訪只是考量因素，沒有聚會。

choices.t: How to set up an extra room
choices.zh: 如何佈置多出來的房間
choices.why: 全段圍繞備用臥室要如何規劃。

choices.t: How to paint the living room
choices.why: 漆牆是針對備用房，且只是其中一項安排。

choices.t: Which monitors to buy
choices.why: 螢幕只是男士需要放置的物品之一。

q.t: Why does the man say, "A sofa bed would take up too much space"?
q.zh: 男士為什麼說「沙發床會佔太多空間」？

choices.t: To suggest leaving the room empty
choices.why: 他想要的是辦公室，不是空房。

choices.t: To compare furniture prices
choices.why: 價格是後來 W1 提到的。

choices.t: To reject the idea of buying one
choices.zh: 為了否決買沙發床的提議
choices.why: 他是回應 W1 的沙發床建議並說明不適合。

choices.t: To ask for a larger sofa bed
choices.why: 他認為沙發床太佔空間，不會要更大的。

q.t: What can be inferred about the cousin's visit?
q.zh: 關於表妹的來訪可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: She will probably sleep on a fold-out mattress.
choices.zh: 她很可能睡在摺疊床墊上。
choices.why: 大家採用摺疊床墊方案，並將在她來時使用。

choices.t: She will stay at a hotel.
choices.why: 她要住在他們家。

choices.t: She will bring her own sofa bed.
choices.why: 沙發床是 W1 提議，且被否決。

choices.t: She will visit for just one weekend.
choices.why: 她要待幾個星期，不是一個週末。
